:root{--plum:#42264e;--lilac:#9476b0;--pale:#f8f3fa;--gold:#b58d48;--ink:#4a3a4b}*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:#fffdfd;color:var(--ink);font-family:Jost,sans-serif;font-weight:300;overflow-x:hidden}h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Cormorant 0;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px;color:var(--plum)}.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--plum);border-radius:100px;padding:14px 28px;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:500;transition:.2s}.btn:hover{background:var(--plum);color:white}.hero .btn{margin-top:34px}.section{max-width:950px;margin:auto;padding:95px 22px;text-align:center}.section h2{font-size:clamp(39px,6vw,62px);margin:10px 0 20px}.section 24px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5d9ed;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 15px 45px #51305b0a}.event-card .date{font:66px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--plum);line-height:1}.event-card .month{font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}.event-card h3{font-size:36px;margin:20px 0 10px}.event-card .when{font-size:14px;color:#80648e}.event-card p{font-size:14px}.venue{background:var(--pale);border-radius:24px;padding:50px 24px;margin-top:25px}.qr-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:28px auto 6px}.qr-box img{background:white;padding:10px;border:1px solid .btn:hover{background:#6a4978}.countdown{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:30px auto}.countdown div{width:100px;padding:15px 7px;border:1px solid #e5d9ed;border-radius:14px;background:#fff}.countdown b{display:block;font:36px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--plum)}.countdown span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#866a9e}.closing{padding:75px 20px 55px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(#fff,#f8f0f9)}.script{font:45px 'Great Vibes',cursive;color:var(--gold)}.closing h2{font-size:38px;margin:10px 0}.closing p{font:italic 20px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif}.fine{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#80648e;margin-top:40px}.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .8s,transform .8s}.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}@media(max-width:640px){.event-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.section{padding:72px 18px}.event-card{padding:35px 18px}.countdown div{width:75px}.countdown
